record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: The source notes that there is a duality theory for ordinary multi-norms that returns a multi-norm rather than a dual multi-norm. Is there an analogous duality theory for p-multi-norms that returns a p-multi-norm rather than a p' -multi-norm?

evidence.quote: In [ 9 ], there is a duality theory for multi-norms that gives a multi-norm (not a dual multi-norm). Is there a similar duality theory for p -multi-norms that gives a p -multi-norm (not a \(p'\) -multi-norm)?

artifact.status_search_result: A search of the literature on multi-norms and $p$-multi-norms (Dales–Polyakov; later developments by Daws, Pham, Ramsden, Laustsen, Oikhberg, Troitsky, and others, including the power-norm framework) does not turn up an explicit construction of a duality theory for $p$-multi-norms whose output is again a $p$-multi-norm rather than a $p'$-multi-norm. No source clearly resolves the question in either direction, so the status appears to be unknown/open.

status_evidence.title: Power-normed spaces
status_evidence.snippet: The class of ℓp-power-norms contains the p-multi-norms defined by Dales et al. and coincides with multi-norms and dual multi-norms in the extremal cases.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms the framework of p-multi-norms with standard duality between p- and p'-multi-norms but does not exhibit a self-dual p-multi-norm duality.

status_evidence.title: Multi-norms and Banach lattices (Dales et al.)
status_evidence.snippet: Multi-norms and dual multi-norms, with duality theories relating them.
status_evidence.claim: Discusses duality of multi-norms but the question of a p-multi-norm-to-p-multi-norm duality is not addressed in the cited results.
